playerMessage: Spinning gold coins now float through the desert! Some form an arc above a cactus, so a full jump over it grabs them all. Others sit in a low row between the cacti, so you can collect them just by running through. Each coin is worth 5 points, and you'll see a sparkle and a "+5" when you grab one.

prompt: Add coins floating in the air to collect.
playerMessage: Coins now float in the air above some of the cactus groups. Jump over a cactus to grab them: each coin adds 5 points, and a COINS counter sits in the top-right corner, just under your score. The coins spin and bob, and a little ring pops out when you collect one.

prompt: Let the robot double jump.
playerMessage: Your robot can now double jump! While it's in the air, press Space, tap the screen, or click, and it will jump again with a little jet-pack puff and a quick backflip. You get one extra jump each time you leave the ground, and it refreshes when you land. This makes it much easier to clear tall cactus groups and reach the high coins.

prompt: Let the robot double jump.
playerMessage: Your robot can now double jump! While it's in the air, press Space (or tap) again for a quick backflip. The second jump is a little lower than the first, and it refreshes every time the robot lands. The title screen now shows a hint about it so you know how to use it.

Make an endless runner where a little robot jumps over cactuses and it gets faster over time.
Make the robot jump a little higher.
playerMessage: Your robot now jumps a bit higher! Press the jump button as before, and hold it for an even higher jump or tap it quickly for a short hop. Everything else in the game works just like it did.

prompt: The double jump only works once, then it never works again. Please fix it.
playerMessage: The double jump now works on every jump, not just the first. Before, the extra jump only came back when the game started or restarted, so it stayed used up after you landed. Now it refills every time your robot lands. Press jump again in mid-air to flip, then land and do it again.

prompt: Make a match-3 puzzle game with cute fruit.
playerMessage: I made you a match-3 puzzle game with six cute fruit faces (apple, orange, lemon, grape, lime and peach) on a pastel candy background! To start, tap or press Space. Swap two neighbouring fruits by swiping toward one, or by tapping one fruit and then the one beside it. Line up 3 or more of the same fruit to clear them, and chain reactions give you combo bonuses. You have 60 seconds, and each match adds a little time back, so have fun!

prompt: Make a puzzle game where you push boxes onto targets, with 5 levels that get harder.
playerMessage: Box Push is ready: a puzzle game with 5 levels that get harder. Push the boxes onto the pink targets, and each box turns green once it's in place. Move with the arrow keys or WASD, press Z to undo, R to restart, and Space to start or go to the next level.

prompt: Add coins floating in the air to collect.
playerMessage: Coins now float in the air above the cactus, and you can collect them by jumping through them. Each coin adds 10 points to your score, and a Coins counter in the top-left corner shows how many you've grabbed. Your coin total also appears on the game-over screen.

prompt: Let the robot double jump.
playerMessage: Your robot can now jump a second time while it's in the air! Press Space, tap, or click again after your first jump, and it does a little flip with a puff of dust. It can't jump a third time until it lands again.

prompt: Make a match-3 puzzle game with cute fruit.
playerMessage: I made **Fruit Frenzy**, a match-3 puzzle game with six cute fruits, each with its own little face. Swap neighboring fruits by dragging one onto another, or by tapping one and then tapping a neighbor, and line up three or more to clear them. You can also use the arrow keys to move a cursor and Space to swap. You have 60 seconds to score as many points as you can, and new fruit join the board at 20 and 40 seconds.

prompt: Add birds that fly at head height; press Down or swipe down to duck under them.
playerMessage: Birds now fly across at head height once the game speeds up. Hold Down or S to duck under them, or swipe down on a touch screen. The title screen also shows this new control.

prompt: Make an endless runner where a little robot jumps over cactuses and it gets faster over time.
playerMessage: Robo Dash is ready! Your little robot rolls through a sunset desert, jumping over cacti, and it speeds up the longer you survive. Tap, click, or press Space to jump, and hold the button for a higher leap. Grab the gold coins floating above the cacti for +5 points each, then tap again after a crash to try to beat your best score!

prompt: Make an endless runner where a little robot jumps over cactuses and it gets faster over time.
playerMessage: Robo Dash is ready! A little robot runs through a desert at sunset, jumping over cactuses while the game gets faster the longer you survive. Press Space, Up, W, or click/tap to jump, and hold it a little longer for a higher jump. Grab coins for +5 points each, and try to beat your best score!

prompt: Make an endless runner where a little robot jumps over cactuses and it gets faster over time.
playerMessage: I made you a desert robot runner! A little silver robot runs through the sand, jumps over cacti, and grabs coins for 5 points each. It gets faster the longer you survive, and your best score is saved between visits. Press Space, Up, W, click, or tap to start and jump, and release early for a shorter hop. Tap again after a crash to run again.

prompt: Make an endless runner where a little robot jumps over cactuses and it gets faster over time.
playerMessage:
Robo Run is ready! Your little robot dashes through the desert, hopping over cactuses and collecting gold bolts for points. The longer you survive, the faster it gets, and the game-over screen remembers your best score.

To jump, press Space, Up, or W, or click or tap the screen. A quick tap gives a short hop. Press Space or click to start, and again to run after a crash.

prompt: Make a puzzle game where you push boxes onto targets, with 5 levels that get harder.
playerMessage: Your box-pushing puzzle game is ready, with 5 levels that start easy with one box and build up to a four-box room with walls. Every level can be solved. You play as a little blue character and push each orange box onto a gold target; boxes turn green once they're in place. Move with the arrow keys or WASD, and use the Undo (Z) and Restart (R) buttons in the bottom corners if you get stuck. Each level earns up to 3 stars based on how few moves you use, and your progress is saved.

prompt: Make a match-3 puzzle game with cute fruit.
playerMessage: Fruity Swap is ready! It's an 8×8 match-3 board full of cute faced fruit: cherries, strawberries, oranges, lemons, grapes and blueberries. To play, swipe a fruit toward a neighbour, or tap one fruit and then a neighbour. On a keyboard, use the arrow keys or WASD and press Space. Reach the score goal before your moves run out, and chain reactions give you bonus moves. Undo and Restart are in the bottom corners, and your best score is saved between sessions.

prompt: Make a match-3 puzzle game with cute fruit.
playerMessage: Fruit Crush is ready! Fruit burst into bits when they clear, squash when they land, and make funny faces on combos. Swipe a fruit toward a neighbor, or tap two touching fruit, to swap them. Line up three or more of the same fruit to clear them, and reach the goal before your 20 moves run out. On a keyboard, use the arrow keys to move, press Space to pick up a fruit, then press an arrow to swap.

prompt: Make a match-3 puzzle game with cute fruit.
playerMessage:
Fruit Frenzy got a fun makeover! Fruit now squishes when it lands and gently bobs while it waits. Every match sparkles, makes a sound, and shows a little "+points" pop-up, and combos shake the board with a rising chime. When you clear a round you earn 1–3 stars with confetti, plus a "New best score!" message when you beat your record. The title screen has bouncing fruit too.

To play, swipe a fruit toward its neighbor, or tap a fruit and then tap one next to it. You can also use the arrow keys and Space.

prompt: Make an endless runner where a little robot jumps over cactuses and it gets faster over time.
playerMessage:
Robo Run is now more polished: the robot stretches when it jumps and squashes when it lands, kicks up dust as it runs, and the screen shakes when you crash. The sun glows, clouds drift by, and there are sounds for jumping, landing, crashing, every 100 points, and new bests. Your best score is saved, so you can try to beat it next time.

To jump, tap, click, or press Space, and hold for a higher jump. The game speeds up the longer you survive, so keep those cacti in sight!

prompt: Make an endless runner where a little robot jumps over cactuses and it gets faster over time.
playerMessage: Your little robot runner has a fresh new look! It now has jumping squash-and-stretch with dust puffs, fun sounds, drifting clouds and a glowing sun, and a more dramatic crash with sparks and a red flash. Press Space, Up, W, or click/tap to jump over the cactuses, and watch out, the game gets faster the longer you run!

prompt: Make a match-3 puzzle game with cute fruit.
playerMessage: Fruit Match is ready to play, and the controls are the same as before. Swap two neighbouring fruits to make rows or columns of three or more and clear them. Each cleared fruit now bursts into sparkles, fruits squash and bounce when they land, and long combo chains shake the board with a bigger "Combo" pop-up. You'll hear short sounds for matches, combos, wins and losses, and clearing a stage drops confetti.

prompt: Make a match-3 puzzle game with cute fruit.
playerMessage: I made Fruit Frenzy, a match-3 puzzle game with cute fruit. The fruit now burst into colour when cleared, squash when they land, and the board shakes on combos and wins. Each move has a sound, wins come with confetti, and bubbles drift behind the board. To play, tap a fruit and then a neighbour, drag one into place, or use the arrow keys or WASD and Space. Line up 3 or more to score, and chain reactions earn extra points. Your best score is saved and shown on the title screen.

prompt: Make a match-3 puzzle game with cute fruit.
playerMessage: Fruit Crush is now livelier: fruit squashes when swapped, matches throw off sparkles, and big chains shake the board with a "Combo" message. There are sounds for swaps, matches, shuffles, and winning or losing, and if you pause for six seconds a possible move glows. To play, drag a fruit onto a neighbour, tap two fruit, or use the arrow keys and Space. Reach 1200 points within 30 moves to win!

prompt: Make a match-3 puzzle game with cute fruit.
playerMessage:
Fruity Crush just got a lot more fun! Fruit now squashes when you swap it, pops with colourful bursts, and gently bobs as it waits. Big combos shake the board, and winning a round sends confetti flying. Your best score is saved for next time.

To play, swap neighbouring fruit by swiping, tapping two pieces, or using the arrow keys and Space. Line up three or more to score, and reach the goal before your 25 moves run out!
